title: Strict henselization presentation over the actual scheme stalk
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\bar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ a geometric point with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point]. Put $x=\bar x(*)$, $C=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and $k=C/\mathfrak m_C$ [def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. Fix the embedding $k\to\Omega$ to be the one induced by the local map of $\bar x$, and let $K$ be the separable algebraic closure of $k$ inside $\Omega$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure]. Give $K$ its $C$-algebra structure through $C\to k\to K$. There exist a commutative local ring $H$, a $C$-algebra structure on it, a specified pointed-etale colimit presentation $P$ making it the strict henselization of $C$ relative to $K$ [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization], and a ring isomorphism $\theta:\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{X,\bar x}\simeq H$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], such that $\operatorname{Spec}(\theta)$ followed by the structural morphism to $X$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map] equals $\operatorname{Spec}(C\to H)$ followed by $\operatorname{Spec}C\to X$, and $H\xrightarrow{P.\mathrm{residueMap}}K\hookrightarrow\Omega$ composed with $\theta$ equals the canonical geometric evaluation [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-point-evaluation]. There is no Noetherian assumption.

proof.text: Apply the strict-henselization residue-triple construction to C and its specified separable closure K. Send a pointed etale algebra to the prime kernel of its pointing and the induced residue embedding; in the reverse direction compose the residue embedding with the residue quotient. These inverse functors preserve the C-algebra diagram and all evaluations. Transport the colimit to obtain the specified presentation P and the local ring H.

Choose an affine chart Spec D at x and lift the geometric point through it, with prime p. The affine-open stalk isomorphism C = D_p preserves chart germs and induces the given residue-field embedding into Omega. Transport P along this isomorphism and the corresponding identification of the separable closures inside Omega. Apply the affine strict-local comparison to obtain theta. Its structural equation becomes the equation with X.fromSpecStalk x because the stalk isomorphism preserves germs. The evaluation equation is preserved by the same residue embedding. Transport the local-ring structure back to H.

theorem geometricStrictLocal_stalk_presentation
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X)
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)))) Ω]
    (hΩ : algebraMap
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)))) Ω =
        (descResidueField (stalkClosedPointTo x)).hom)
    [Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)))
      (separableClosure
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)))) Ω)]
    [IsScalarTower (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))))
      (separableClosure
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)))) Ω)] :
    ∃ (H : Type u) (_ : CommRing H)
      (_ : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) H)
      (P : Algebra.StrictHenselizationPresentationIn
        (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)))
        (separableClosure
          (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)))) Ω) H)
      (_ : IsLocalRing H) (θ : strictHenselizationRing x ≃+* H),
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom θ.toRingHom) ≫ strictHenselizationStructuralMap x =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω))) H)) ≫
            X.fromSpecStalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)) ∧
      (separableClosure
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField
          (X.presheaf.stalk (x (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω)))) Ω).subtype.comp
          (P.residueMap.comp θ.toRingHom) = strictHenselizationPointEvaluation x
